parsed.label: negative for common nouns/verbs in code comments describing upcoming code
parsed.trigger_hypothesis: The neuron fires negatively on common nouns or verbs in code comments that describe an action or object referenced immediately afterward in the code (e.g., 'level', 'circle', 'apply', 'next').
parsed.output_hypothesis: It may suppress generic descriptive terms in comments to avoid redundancy when the code will specify the entity.
alternatives: negative for any token in a code comment
negative for the object of a preposition in code comments
parsed.adapter_changes: State C+1 reduces negative magnitude for some tokens (e.g., 'it', 'next'), weakening suppression for pronouns/directionals.

proposed_tests.discriminates: comment noun describing upcoming code vs same noun in non-comment

{
  "label": "negative for common nouns/verbs in code comments describing upcoming code",
  "trigger_hypothesis": "The neuron fires negatively on common nouns or verbs in code comments that describe an action or object referenced immediately afterward in the code (e.g., 'level', 'circle', 'apply', 'next').",
  "output_hypothesis": "It may suppress generic descriptive terms in comments to avoid redundancy when the code will specify the entity.",
  "alternatives": ["negative for any token in a code comment", "negative for the object of a preposition in code comments"],
  "adapter_changes": "State C+1 reduces negative magnitude for some tokens (e.g., 'it', 'next'), weakening suppression for pronouns/directionals.",
  "supporting": ["W01", "W04", "W06", "W07", "W08", "W09", "W11", "W12"],
  "contradicting": ["W13", "W14", "W15", "W16", "W17", "W18", "W19", "W20", "W21", "W22", "W23", "W24", "W25", "W26"],
  "proposed_tests": [
    {"discriminates": "comment noun describing upcoming code vs same noun in non-comment", "texts": [{"text": "# compute the area of a circle", "expected": "negative", "target": "circle"}, {"text": "shape = circle", "expected": "low", "target": ""}]},
    {"discriminates": "comment verb for subsequent action vs same verb in non-comment", "texts": [{"text": "# apply f to every element", "expected": "negative", "target": "apply"}, {"text": "def apply(f):", "expected": "low", "target": ""}]},
    {"discriminates": "comment noun with immediate reference vs delayed", "texts": [{"text": "# visit the next node", "expected": "negative", "target": "next"}, {"text": "# visit a node later", "expected": "low", "target": ""}]},
    {"discriminates": "comment in code vs same phrase in neutral text", "texts": [{"text": "# running sum of the values", "expected": "negative", "target": "running"}, {"text": "The running sum is high.", "expected": "low", "target": ""}]},
    {"discriminates": "comment describing direct object vs subject", "texts": [{"text": "# read the config file", "expected": "negative", "target": "config"}, {"text": "# config file is read", "expected": "low", "target": ""}]},
    {"discriminates": "comment with article+noun vs noun alone", "texts": [{"text": "# the level in the tank", "expected": "negative", "target": "level"}, {"text": "# level in tank", "expected": "negative", "target": "level"}]},
    {"discriminates": "comment before code vs after code", "texts": [{"text": "# initialise the counter to zero", "expected": "negative", "target": "initialise"}, {"text": "counter = 0 # initialise", "expected": "low", "target": ""}]},
    {"discriminates": "common noun in comment vs proper noun", "texts": [{"text": "# compute the area of a circle", "expected": "negative", "target": "circle"}, {"text": "# compute the area of a Circle class", "expected": "low", "target": ""}]},
    {"discriminates": "verb in comment for immediate action vs general", "texts": [{"text": "# apply f to every element", "expected": "negative", "target": "apply"}, {"text": "# we apply f", "expected": "low", "target": ""}]},
    {"discriminates": "pronoun in comment referencing code vs neutral", "texts": [{"text": "# parse it", "expected": "negative", "target": "it"}, {"text": "it is parsed", "expected": "low", "target": ""}]}
  ],
  "confidence": "medium",
  "no_coherent_hypothesis": false
}
